question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

John is very __generous__; he regularly gives alms to the poor.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"generous"** means showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)

 
 
• **Example:** The** generous** donation from the philanthropist helped build a new library.
 
 
 
• **"Kind"** refers to being friendly, generous, and considerate. (दयालु)
 
 
• **Example:** She is always **kind** to her neighbors and helps them whenever she can.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **kind**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Great** (महान): Of an extent, amount, or intensity considerably above the normal or average.

 
 
• **Example:** He achieved **great **success in his career.
 
 
 
• **Shrewd** (चतुर): Having or showing sharp powers of judgment; astute.
 
 
• **Example:** The** shrewd** businessman made a profitable deal.
 
 
 
• **Popular** (लोकप्रिय): Liked or admired by many people or by a particular person or group.
 
 
• **Example:** The new café has become very **popular** among the locals.
